summary: Learn to assess governance results, check evidence and prepare decision briefs. Explore the five-day course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation in governance systems helps governance teams assess whether oversight and commitments produce institutional results. For governance analysts, policy officers and oversight leads, the course covers mapping results chains, defining indicators, checking administrative evidence and framing evaluation questions to support decision-focused recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess governance performance, track institutional commitments or prepare oversight findings and recommendations.
prerequisites: No formal monitoring and evaluation experience is required. Familiarity with governance, public programmes or performance reporting is useful.
